scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:unittest && npm run coverage:js
scripts.coverage:unittest: python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests/unittest && python -m coverage report -m
scripts.coverage:js: c8 --src js --include "js/utils/certificados.js" --include "js/controllers/CertificadoController.js" --include "js/controllers/ArchivoController.js" --include "js/models/CertificadoModel.js" --check-coverage --per-file --lines 90 --statements 90 --functions 90 --branches 90 --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary python -m unittest discover -s tests/unittest
scripts.coverage:js:todo: c8 --all --src js --include "js/**/*.js" --exclude "js/vendor/**" --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary python -m unittest discover -s tests/unittest
scripts.test:unitarias: python -m unittest discover -s tests/unittest && node --test tests/security/*.test.cjs
scripts.coverage:lcov: c8 --all --src js --src api --src server --include "js/**/*.js" --include "api/**/*.js" --include "server/**/*.js" --exclude "js/vendor/**" --reporter=lcov --reporter=text-summary npm run -s test:unitarias
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore --project demo-jal-audit "node --test tests/integration/rules.test.cjs tests/integration/certificados.rules.test.cjs"
